title: Building Scalable Component Architectures
excerpt: How I structure reusable, maintainable component systems in React and Vue.
content: A scalable frontend starts with clear component boundaries. Small, focused components compose into features without becoming tangled.
Co-locate state with the components that use it, and lift it only when genuinely shared. Predictable data flow keeps large apps maintainable.
Design systems pay off fast: a shared set of primitives means new screens are assembled, not rebuilt.

title: State Management Without the Headache
excerpt: Choosing between Redux Toolkit, Vuex, and local state — and when each fits.
content: Most state is local. Reach for a global store only when data is truly shared across distant parts of the tree.
Redux Toolkit removes most of the old boilerplate; Vuex (or Pinia) does the same in the Vue world.
Keep server state separate from UI state — they have different lifecycles and caching needs.

title: Shipping Fast, Responsive UIs
excerpt: Practical performance and UX wins that make apps feel instant.
content: Performance is a feature. Measure first, then optimize the parts users actually feel.
Lazy-load below-the-fold work, keep bundles lean, and avoid layout shift for a calm, fast experience.
Responsive, accessible interfaces aren't extra — they're the baseline for a quality product.
